title: How to make a Gumpaste Cosmos Flower Tutorial
description:
Hi and welcome back to my kitchen. For this weeks video I really wanted to create a new gumpaste flower tutorial for you, so I am going to show you how to make these pretty Cosmos sugar flowers.

These would look great added to a birthday or wedding cake. Throughout the video I show you step by step how I made the flowers.

➡️ Plus for my flower bud tutorial click here: https://youtu.be/yAtYwybqdAQ
